title: Website Foundation Context

field_definitions.project_type: One or more project-type taxonomy values
field_definitions.website_types: One or more website-type taxonomy values
field_definitions.existing_website: URL, inventory status, and audit evidence
field_definitions.capabilities: Capability records with status and evidence
field_definitions.constraints: Budget, timeline, technology, content, legal, and operational constraints

rules: Unknown values must remain unknown rather than being filled with guesses.
Every customer-specific claim must have a provenance reference.
Observed, requested, recommended, approved, and tested states must remain distinguishable.
The record_template is an illustrative contract, not a formal JSON Schema validator.
Schema validation and cross-file identifier validation should be implemented separately.
